I have resolved the issue by configuring the ProGuard / R8 rules in [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r2/work/app/proguard-rules.pro).

### Cause
In minified release builds (`isMinifyEnabled = true`), R8 strips generic type signatures by default. Gson's `TypeToken` relies on the generic superclass signature at runtime to identify the target type (`List<Book>`), resulting in `IllegalStateException: TypeToken must be created with a type argument...`. Additionally, R8 could obfuscate or strip model class fields deserialized by reflection.

### Changes Made
Added rules to [app/proguard-rules.pro](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c4-agy-A-r2/work/app/proguard-rules.pro):
- `-keepattributes Signature` and `-keepattributes *Annotation*`: Preserves generic signatures and annotations required by Gson reflection.
- `-keep class com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken { *; }` and `-keep class * extends com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken`: Preserves `TypeToken` and anonymous subclasses instantiated for generic type capture.
- `-keep class vn.shelftap.lab.model.** { *; }`: Preserves model classes and their field names so Gson can deserialize JSON into `Book` objects correctly.
